## Buenro - Senior Backend Engineer

🔗 [Apply](https://buenro.factorialhr.com/job_posting/senior-backend-engineer-326026)

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Senior Backend Engineer building Buenro’s event ticketing and accommodation marketplace backend. Developing scalable Node.js/NestJS services for a global destination-events marketplace.
Senior Backend Engineer building Buenro’s event ticketing and accommodation marketplace platform
- Tech stack: Angular, AWS, JavaScript, Jest, Microservices, MongoDB, Node.js, NoSQL, Postgres, RabbitMQ, React, Terraform, TypeScript, Vue.js
- Build and maintain the Buenro platform
- Work closely with Frontend/Mobile and Systems & Platform teams
- Develop and maintain backend infrastructure
- Build new features and functionality for the Buenro platform
- Implement robust, maintainable backend services using Node.js and NestJS
- Debug production issues across the stack using logs, metrics, and traces
- Improve backend APIs and middleware
- Optimize authentication and RBAC/ABAC practices
- Minimum 5+ years of experience in backend applications and API development
- Expert-level proficiency in Node.js and NestJS, including dependency injection, guards, interceptors, modules, and decorators
- Expert-level proficiency in TypeScript, including advanced types, generics, utility types, and strict mode
- Strong MongoDB skills, including indexes, aggregation pipelines, sharding, replica sets, and schema design
- Strong PostgreSQL skills, including complex joins, transactions, and JSONB
- Prisma ORM expertise, including schema modeling, migrations, query optimization, and middleware
- Production experience with GitHub Actions, including workflows, secrets, matrix builds, and reusable actions
- Production experience with Terraform, including modules, state management, providers, and drift detection

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior Backend Engineer building Buenro’s event ticketing and accommodation marketplace backend. Developing scalable Node.js/NestJS services for a global destination-events marketplace.
Senior Backend Engineer building Buenro’s event ticketing and accommodation marketplace platform
Role description:
• Build and maintain the Buenro platform
• Work closely with Frontend/Mobile and Systems & Platform teams
• Develop and maintain backend infrastructure
• Build new features and functionality for the Buenro platform
• Implement robust, maintainable backend services using Node.js and NestJS
• Debug production issues across the stack using logs, metrics, and traces
• Improve backend APIs and middleware
• Optimize authentication and RBAC/ABAC practices
• Work with message queues and in-memory databases to improve performance and efficiency
• Deliver low-latency, secure, and fault-tolerant backend solutions
• Ensure world-class availability, performance, and scalability
Role requirements:
• Minimum 5+ years of experience in backend applications and API development
• Expert-level proficiency in Node.js and NestJS, including dependency injection, guards, interceptors, modules, and decorators
• Expert-level proficiency in TypeScript, including advanced types, generics, utility types, and strict mode
• Strong MongoDB skills, including indexes, aggregation pipelines, sharding, replica sets, and schema design
• Strong PostgreSQL skills, including complex joins, transactions, and JSONB
• Prisma ORM expertise, including schema modeling, migrations, query optimization, and middleware
• Production experience with GitHub Actions, including workflows, secrets, matrix builds, and reusable actions
• Production experience with Terraform, including modules, state management, providers, and drift detection
• Production experience with AWS ECS, including task definitions, service networking, load balancing, IAM roles, and CloudWatch
• Strong understanding of RESTful API design, OpenAPI/Swagger, JWT authentication, and rate limiting
• Expertise with NoSQL databases, document modeling, data denormalization, consistency models, and performance tuning in distributed environments
• Deep understanding of asynchronous programming, event-driven architecture, and message queues such as SQS and RabbitMQ
• Familiarity with unit testing using Jest, integration testing, and end-to-end testing with Supertest and Playwright
• Experience with microservices, domain-driven design, and CQRS patterns is a plus
• Front-end experience with React, Angular, or Vue.js is a strong plus
• Previous experience leading teams and coaching or mentoring engineers is a strong plus
• Ability to work remotely within a timezone difference of approximately +/- 3–4 hours from CET
Benefits:
• Fully remote work-from-home arrangement
• Equity through the company option plan
• Generous time off
• One week each year when the whole company switches off together
• Access to at-cost accommodations at Buenro's global bases around the world
Tech stack:
Angular, AWS, JavaScript, Jest, Microservices, MongoDB, Node.js, NoSQL, Postgres, RabbitMQ, React, Terraform, TypeScript, Vue.js
